product.title: Gran Perla Granite
product.description: Gran Perla granite is a magnificent black and grey speckled stone that is ideal for kitchen countertops, bathroom vanity tops, bathtub surrounds, fireplace surrounds and outdoor living spaces. If you are looking for a neutral-colored surface that is pleasing to the eye, Gran Perla granite may be just what you are looking for. Whether you install it as a new kitchen countertop, bathroom vanity top, bathtub surround, fireplace surround, outdoor kitchen countertop or any other home surfaces, Gran Perla granite will look amazing. Considering the high-quality appearance and its ability to stand up to wear and tear in any space, Gran Perla granite is a great option for any home. Granite in general can also increase the overall value of your home. Installing Gran Perla granite can very well end up being one of the best investments you ever make for your home.
